Subject: Discovery: POC trajectory, success hypothesis & access next steps

Hi Tom / Elena —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap + proposed trajectory so we’re aligned before kickoff. I’ve attached a short MOM and a starter prompt/eval CSV.

Top pains you described
- Inference cost variability (spiky token costs during peak queries)
- Occasional latency spikes on short, high-frequency queries (impacting UX)
- Prompt fragility: user prompts moving between contexts cause regressions
- Need for clear telemetry and reproducible evals for product signoff (SOC2 controls needed)

Stated goals (what success looks like for the POC)
- 90th percentile latency <= 250ms for the set of short queries in our baseline workload
- Reduce per-request unit cost by ~35–45% vs current baseline via batching/cache/quantization without degrading answer quality
- Pass rate >= 88% on your labeled prompt set (we’ll use the attached mvp-eval-promptset.csv)
- Deliver reproducible eval harness and a short readout with telemetry hooks for procurement/security review

Proposed pilot scope & runbook (high level)
- Baseline week (Week 0): access + baseline run against your sample dataset (we’ll capture perf and quality)
- Experiment week (Week 1–2): enable batching, prefix caching, and a small quantization profile; run prompt-eval slate and surface tradeoffs
- Stabilize & readout (Week 3): tuned config, dashboard handoff, and final recommendation for production routing

Owners
- FathomAI: Tom (Product lead), Elena (ML / evaluation owner), Priya (procurement)
- Redwood: Naomi (CSM / engagement lead), Karthik (solutions/eng lead), Jordan (observability + infra)

Immediate access needs (to unblock week 0)
1) A minimal dataset: 500–1,000 representative short queries + labeled expected responses (S3 link or Drive).
2) A test API key or temporary endpoint and example request/response shapes.
3) Contact for procurement / SOC2/PII requirements (we’ll scope the compliance evidence you need).

Suggested kickoff: Tue Sep 8 or Wed Sep 9, 10–11am PT for a 45 min alignment + environment handoff.

Next steps (my side)
- Share the short MOM and the prompt/eval CSV (attached).
- Send an access checklist (redwood-access-steps.md) and temporary console invite.

Thanks — will follow up after you confirm preferred kickoff time.

—

Naomi — thanks for the thorough summary, this matches our notes. A couple quick clarifications from our side: 

- Procurement / compliance: Priya is our procurement lead (CC’ed). We’ll need SOC2 evidence and a short data-retention & access matrix before we finalize any reserved capacity.
- Dataset: we can drop a sanitized sample S3 export (about 800 short queries) — Elena will upload by EOD Monday.
- Evaluation metric: the 88% pass rate is the right north star; we’ll also track precision on the top-1 extracted fact as a secondary metric.

Kickoff: Sep 9 10am PT works for me (let’s lock that). Also, does Redwood require VPC peering for the initial baseline or can we start with a temporary test endpoint? If peering is required we’ll loop infra and that will push the schedule a few days.

One more ask: can you include a short list of the observability signals Redwood will surface (token-level latency, 95/99 pct, loss/quality per prompt id)? We’ll share that with our SREs.
